A General Framework for Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Jialin Song, Yuxin Chen, Yisong Yue CaltechAUTHORS (California Institute of Technology) 2019-04-01 link
单位: - Caltech
通讯: Jialin Song @ - Caltech
相关性: 该论文提出的多保真贝叶斯优化框架可显著降低昂贵仿真（如FEA）的采样成本，并支持多目标约束优化，适用于植入物设计优化。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification for surrogate predictions.
动机· 如何高效利用多保真度信息源优化未知函数，降低采样成本。
方法· 提出MF-MI-Greedy框架，基于共享潜在关系的加性高斯过程建模，结合成本敏感互信息增益。
结果· 在合成和真实数据集上优于现有方法，并证明了低遗憾界。
验证· 数值基准测试和真实数据集验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To efficiently optimize an unknown function by intelligently trading off multiple information sources with different costs and complex dependencies.
Method· Proposes MF-MI-Greedy, a multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization framework using additive Gaussian processes with shared latent structure and cost-sensitive mutual information acquisition.
Result· Achieves low regret and outperforms existing methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
Validation· Validated on numerical benchmarks and real-world datasets (e.g., materials design).

相关性: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V粉末回收对LPBF工艺和力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向间接相关。
边界: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the user's direction.
动机· 研究Ti-6Al-4V粉末回收对LPBF工艺和零件性能的影响
方法· 定义平均使用时间参数，分析粉末回收对流动性和拉伸性能的影响

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of Ti-6Al-4V powder recycling on the processability and mechanical properties of LPBF parts.
Method· A novel average usage time (AUT) parameter is defined to quantify powder recycling, and its effect on powder characteristics and tensile properties is experimentally studied.
Result· Powder recycling affects flowability and tensile strength, but safe reuse is possible with controlled virgin-to-used powder ratios.
Validation· Experimental validation through powder characterization and tensile testing of LPBF-fabricated specimens.

Uncertainty Quantification for Basin Scale Heat Flow Models with a Physics-Based Machine Learning Approach

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Denise Degen, Karen Veroy, Florian Wellmann, Magdalena Scheck‐Wenderoth Publication Database GFZ (GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences) 2019-04-01 link
相关性: 该论文使用降阶模型加速地热模拟的不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模。
边界: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on geothermal heat flow models.
动机· 地热勘探需要高效的不确定性量化方法，但传统方法计算成本过高。
方法· 采用降阶模型（物理信息机器学习）加速前向模拟，实现百万次采样。
结果· 相比标准有限元，计算速度提升4-6个数量级，生成全盆地温度不确定性图。
验证· 以勃兰登堡盆地模型为例进行数值模拟验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Efficient uncertainty quantification is needed for geothermal exploration, but traditional methods are computationally prohibitive for high-resolution basin-scale models.
Method· A reduced basis method, a physics-based machine learning approach, is introduced to accelerate forward simulations by four to six orders of magnitude compared to standard finite element simulations.
Result· The method enables generation of uncertainty maps for subsurface temperatures across the entire basin, demonstrated on the Brandenburg model.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical simulation of a large-scale geological model using the DwarfElephant package.

Validation· Validation against CT-based anatomical anteversion as the gold standard.
